title: Properties of solids and plane shapes
canonical_examples_source: Arithmetic self-verified; method ref: NCERT Class 5/6 Maths; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024 maths.

blocks.content: Shapes are all around us. Flat shapes are called plane shapes; solid shapes take up space. Each has properties we can count and name.
A solid has faces (flat surfaces), edges (where faces meet) and vertices (corners). A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

steps: The edges meet at 8 corners, called vertices.

blocks.explain: A cube has 6 flat square faces.
blocks.rule: A solid's faces are its flat surfaces, edges are where faces meet, vertices are the corners.

practiceItems.prompt: the number of faces on a cube
the number of edges on a cube
the number of vertices on a cube
the number of sides on a square

blocks.content: A plane shape is flat. Name it by counting its straight sides: 3 is a triangle, 4 a quadrilateral, 5 a pentagon.

blocks.explain: A pentagon is a plane shape with 5 straight sides.
blocks.rule: Count the straight sides to name a plane shape.

blocks.content: Solids have faces, edges and vertices; plane shapes are named by their number of sides. Let's practise!
